title: Original and annotation layers
description_en: Keep supplied original, editorial reading, annotations and display styling separate. Never infer an edited reading from appearance.
requirement: Keep supplied original, editorial reading, annotations and display styling separate. Never infer an edited reading from appearance.

title: I/J and U/V policy
description_en: Preserve I/J and U/V from the selected edition. Classical capitals are not authority for converting U to V or deleting J.
requirement: Preserve I/J and U/V from the selected edition. Classical capitals are not authority for converting U to V or deleting J.

title: Ligature and spelling variants
description_en: Keep ae/oe/æ/œ/e distinct according to source and edition; neither medieval nor ecclesiastical mode authorizes blanket conversion.
requirement: Keep ae/oe/æ/œ/e distinct according to source and edition; neither medieval nor ecclesiastical mode authorizes blanket conversion.

title: Length and stress notation
description_en: Preserve macron, breve, acute and apex. Adding marks requires philological context and an authorized separate annotation, not guessed vowel length.
requirement: Preserve macron, breve, acute and apex. Adding marks requires philological context and an authorized separate annotation, not guessed vowel length.

title: Period and usage context
description_en: Record classical, medieval, ecclesiastical, modern or editorial purpose explicitly; the period of composition, manuscript and edition can differ.
requirement: Record classical, medieval, ecclesiastical, modern or editorial purpose explicitly; the period of composition, manuscript and edition can differ.

title: Pronunciation is separate
description_en: Record restored classical or ecclesiastical pronunciation where relevant; pronunciation choice never silently changes source orthography.
requirement: Record restored classical or ecclesiastical pronunciation where relevant; pronunciation choice never silently changes source orthography.

title: Word order and meaning
description_en: Do not rearrange words to fill a layout. Translation, shortening and living-Latin copy require explicit editorial permission and specialist review.
requirement: Do not rearrange words to fill a layout. Translation, shortening and living-Latin copy require explicit editorial permission and specialist review.

title: Latin language versus script
description_en: Latin alphabet or a Latin-looking font does not establish la. English marketing and Lorem ipsum are not evidence of authentic Latin usage.
requirement: Latin alphabet or a Latin-looking font does not establish la. English marketing and Lorem ipsum are not evidence of authentic Latin usage.

title: Unicode and glyph layers
description_en: Preserve composed and decomposed accents and compatibility forms; font ligatures and editorial expansion are distinct from original byte identity.
requirement: Preserve composed and decomposed accents and compatibility forms; font ligatures and editorial expansion are distinct from original byte identity.

title: Verse and epigraphic lines
description_en: Protect verse lineation, physical inscription lines, lacunae and critical apparatus. Distinguish physical line breaks from word boundaries and UI wrapping.
requirement: Protect verse lineation, physical inscription lines, lacunae and critical apparatus. Distinguish physical line breaks from word boundaries and UI wrapping.

title: Font provenance and licensing
description_en: Select actual coverage for macron/breve/ligatures and actual licenses. A revival serif is not a universal ancient-Latin font.
requirement: Select actual coverage for macron/breve/ligatures and actual licenses. A revival serif is not a universal ancient-Latin font.

title: Hierarchy is contextual
description_en: Measure actual reading/display/learning context, font, width and distance. Do not turn observed source ratios into mandatory universal sizes.
requirement: Measure actual reading/display/learning context, font, width and distance. Do not turn observed source ratios into mandatory universal sizes.

title: Accessible multilingual reading
description_en: Review lang=la spans, readable text alternatives, copy/search order and zoom in actual hosts. Static markup does not establish accessibility acceptance.
requirement: Review lang=la spans, readable text alternatives, copy/search order and zoom in actual hosts. Static markup does not establish accessibility acceptance.

title: Edition metadata
description_en: Record source, editorial policy, period and intended use independently; keep unknown fields needs-review rather than inventing scholarly certainty.
requirement: Record source, editorial policy, period and intended use independently; keep unknown fields needs-review rather than inventing scholarly certainty.
